source: Assumed synchronous rotation: a planet 3.5 stellar radii from its star is expected to be tidally locked, and no rotation period or obliquity of WASP-18b is measured; the maps were fitted assuming it (the deposited ThERESA configuration sets prot = porb). Pole, prime meridian and rate are computed from the hosted orbit in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/wasp-18b.json.
coordinateSystem: ICRF/J2000. +Z is the orbit normal (prograde spin); +X points at the host star at each instant, so longitude 0 is the substellar point; east longitude, the direction of rotation.
qualification: Tidal locking and a spin axis on the orbit normal are assumptions, not measurements: neither the rotation period nor the obliquity of WASP-18b is measured.
